description: A `use` effect's `expect:` CEL expression reads a JSON-parsed integer too large for CEL's 64-bit `int` -- the same `ValueError("overflow")` escaping `evaluate_cel_expect` uncaught as the tool case, but `core/use.py`'s own `except (ValueError, RecursionError)` re-raises it immediately, with no retry regardless of `retries.max_attempts`: `meta.error` reads "overflow", `meta.expect` is never set, and `retries_used` never appears. `on_error: fail` wraps it as `"use '<name>' -> <label>: overflow"`.
